messages:
Alex P: Hey @Maria G and @Samir K — looping in for a quick sync on the joint co-sell POC with Cobalt. Partner wants a live demo next week; need alignment on arch, SSO, BYOK, and pricing. Olivia is their eng lead.
Maria G: Ack. Samir, do they need Private/VPC or is Dedicated ok for the POC? Also share the partner eng contact.
Samir K: We scoped Dedicated earlier but they mentioned data residency too. Contact is Olivia Chen <olivia@cobalt.ai>. They asked about AWS KMS and SAML SSO.
Alex P: Two things to decide: 1) security questionnaire items for BYOK/KMS 2) pricing for reserved capacity + overage. CC @Jordan L for infra sizing.
Jordan L: I can own the infra. Ballpark for a 2xA100 dedicated pool w/ autoscale: $16k/mo committed. Can go to $14k/mo on a 6mo commit. Overage ~ $0.012/token. Want me to lock a POC quote?
Priya S: Partner's acceptance targets: p95 latency <200ms for chat, sustained 100 req/s, and function-calling demo for ticket triage. We'll need caching + prefix/KV tuning.
Ethan R: Olivia — quick Q: which KMS provider do you prefer? We support AWS KMS, GCP KMS, and customer HSMs. For security questionnaire, please forward their spreadsheet to security@redwood.com. We also require an NDA addendum for BYOK.
Olivia C (Cobalt): Prefer AWS KMS. We'll send the secQ today. Need SSO metadata (ACS URL + entityID) and SAML cert thumbprint. Also can you confirm EU deployment options (data residency)?
Jordan L: ACS: https://cobalt.redwood-inference.internal/sso/acs  entityID: https://cobalt-idp.cobalt.ai/saml  — we'll provide SAML metadata XML after initial exchange. For EU deploy, we can spin a Dedicated pool in eu-west-1. Network egress rules for Azure-hosted data?
Alex P: Draft POC acceptance criteria: 1) integrated SSO + BYOK; 2) function-calling demo end-to-end; 3) p95 <200ms for 1k-token chat; 4) cost report for 30-day run. Timeline: kickoff Monday, 3-week POC. Major blockers?
Samir K: Legal flagged residency: will they require all logs & telemetry to stay in EU?
Olivia C (Cobalt): Yes — logs and keys must remain in EU. Can you deploy the dedicated pool in eu-west-1 and use customer-controlled keys?
Priya S: That implies Dedicated/EU or Private. Jordan — rough time to provision and configure BYOK + SAML?
Jordan L: Dedicated EU + BYOK + SAML setup is ~5 business days prep if we have IdP metadata and KMS ARN. During POC we can fallback to hosted models for bursts.
Ethan R: I'll prepare the NDA addendum and list the secQ answers we control (SOC2, ISO27001, cert rotation cadence). Also need the partner to confirm their IdP SAML cert expiration date.
Alex P: Samir — can you get their sample dataset size and traffic profile so we can size batching?
Samir K: Olivia — what's sample size and average token length?
Olivia C (Cobalt): Sample set ~10k chat records, avg ~800 tokens per record. We'll also provide a low-sensitivity subset for the demo.
Olivia C (Cobalt): Pricing question: any short-term pilot credits available to offset the POC?
Priya S: We can offer $10k in pilot credits + discounted commit for conversion. I'll follow up with an email with concrete numbers.
Jordan L: Adding infra snippets to runbook: SAML metadata exchange, AWS KMS IAM policy, dedicated pool config. Sample policy:
```yaml
AWSPolicy: 
  Version: "2012-10-17"
  Statement:
    - Effect: "Allow"
      Principal: { Service: "redwood-inference.amazonaws.com" }
      Action: ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"]
      Resource: "arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456789012:key/abc-123"
```
Jordan L: Also sharing a curl to fetch SAML metadata from their IdP (partner to host):
```bash
curl -o idp-metadata.xml https://cobalt.ai/saml/metadata
```
Ethan R: I'll send the NDA addendum to Samir and Olivia for signatures. Security will review the partner secQ once received.
Alex P: Great — I'll update the POC runbook and gating checklist. Next steps: Samir to collect IdP metadata + KMS ARN, Olivia to send secQ and sample data, Jordan to provision EU dedicated pool once we have ARNs. Moving to email threads for the formal quote & NDA. Thanks all :thumbsup:
